Start Your Application
Western will help you pursue your purpose in an environment where you can thrive academically, emotionally, and physically. We focus on your individual well-being so you can better learn the critical skills needed to build a meaningful career and craft a life well-lived. For questions about program details, please contact the department to which you are applying.
If you haven’t accessed your application portal within the past six months, please contact the Graduate College at 269-387-8212 or email admissions-graduate@wmich.edu so we can reactivate your account.

Accelerated Degree Programs
Accelerated Degree Programs
Accelerated Graduate Degree Programs (AGDP) allow current WMU students to apply up to 12 credits towards both their bachelor and master's degrees while being charged at the undergraduate tuition rate, saving both time and money. In the Graduate Application Portal, choose the Degree-Seeking graduate application, then choose the accelerated option to apply to an accelerated program. For example, History - MA Accelerated. See the current list of available Accelerated Graduate Degree Programs.

START YOUR GRADUATE DEGREE OR CERTIFICATE APPLICATION
+150 Advanced Degree Programs
How to apply video
Thank you for your interest in WMU’s graduate programs. We offer a comprehensive list of master’s, specialist and doctoral degrees, as well as numerous graduate certificates. Search our list of programs to find the one that is best for you.
Once you choose your program and determine your application type, please review the application requirements, including general application information for the university, the residency policy, and specific requirements for individual programs, before beginning your application.
University Requirements
An official transcript from the institution from which you earned your Bachelor degree is required, as well as transcripts from those institutions where any graduate level courses or degrees have been taken or completed. Applicants are not required to submit an official transcript of courses taken or completed at Western Michigan University. Departments may request additional course information or transcripts as necessary.
See specific program requirements for details. International applicants may be asked to provide evidence of English language proficiency.
All documents submitted become the property of Western Michigan University and cannot be returned to the applicant or released to other institutions.
Submission of Your Application
Be prepared to pay a nonrefundable application fee online by credit card—$50 for domestic applicants and $100 for international applicants. You will not be able to submit the application without paying the application fee. Payments are processed through a secure server. Please note, programs using a Central Application Service (CAS) where you can apply to multiple schools at once may charge higher fees for this service.
Check your entries as you work; you cannot make changes after you submit the completed application. If you find an error after you’ve submitted the application, use the contact information indicated below. Do not submit a second application.
Your application will be considered complete after all official transcripts, required test scores, or required recommendations are received. Final decisions are made by the academic departments, and the length of the admission process varies by department.
Questions?
If you have any questions about the application process, domestic applicants can email @email or call (269) 387-8212 and international applicants can email @email or call (269) 387-5865 between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. EST, Monday through Friday.
